description: This file contains utility functions for managing filesystem operations such as creating symlinks, copying files, and staging plugin runtimes within a build system for a project involving extensions or plugins, specifically targeting a Webpack or Node.js-based environment.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the symlink type based on the platform, returning 'junction' for Windows and 'dir' for other platforms.

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Calculates the relative path from a source to a target for creating a symlink.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at a target path pointing to a target value, handling existing symlinks or files gracefully.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link from source to target path, utilizing relative paths.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if a file should be wrapped as a module, specifically if it has a '.js' extension.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be copied based on its path ending with specific filenames, such as 'package.json' or plugin configuration files.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a JavaScript file with an ES Module wrapper, exporting its contents.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively copies, wraps, or symlinks files from a source directory to a target directory, excluding node_modules and directories named 'node_modules'.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symlink to the source plugin's node_modules directory within the runtime plugin directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main exported function that stages plugin runtimes from a distribution directory to a runtime directory, handling nested plugins and node_modules.
